caption: The drawing depicts a brown and golden bald eagle with outstretched wings perched on a group of beige and light brown rocks. The eagle is facing slightly to its left, and its head, beak, and talons are clearly defined in the same brownish-gold color as its body and wings. A beige to light brown ribbon or scroll winds through the eagle's beak and over its wings, with the words "E PLURIBUS UNUM" written in capital letters across it. The eagle holds a bundle of arrows in its left talon and an olive branch in its right talon. The background of the drawing is off-white, with no additional objects or details. The overall composition centers the eagle and the objects it holds, and the color palette is dominated by shades of brown, beige, and gold.
title: Eagle from USS Enterprise
